ctx.x: On the street they played E flat?

E flat, yeah, he played the E flats. Now, Larenza Tio, I mean, young Larenza, I mean, he was a very good clarinetist. Charlie McCurtis, he was good. They had Alphonse P. Kool, and I'm talking about the guys that could read at that time. I can remember, they had, you know, Big Al Lover, he was around that time, but he was a musician with those guys. He played Ratty, you know, he was a ratty kind of player. Later on in the years, well, I mean, what, Basher and them fellas came up with. But that Basher, Sidney…
Well, who took his place after he left? Who's that? Basher has been the tops.
